# Whyzer.ai
*Last updated: 2026-07-24*

Whyzer is an AI-powered Point of View (POV) platform for enterprise B2B sellers, built by enterprise sales authority Jamal Reimer.

## What Whyzer Does
Whyzer transforms SEC filings, earnings call transcripts, investor letters, and other public and private financial and operational data into boardroom-ready Points of View — helping AEs speak to executive priorities instead of product features. The positioning wedge is compressing "time-to-executive-engagement": the gap between having research and being in a credible conversation with an executive.

## Global Coverage
Whyzer covers 8,500+ companies in the public and private sectors across 150+ markets worldwide. This includes private companies (e.g. Stripe, Revolut, Monzo) that public-data-only competitors like Databook cannot research. General guideline: target companies should have roughly 100-150+ employees to ensure enough corporate/financial signal exists for analysis.

## Key Features
- AI-generated Master Dossier for any of the 8,500+ public or private companies in Whyzer's database
- Financial KPI extraction from 10-K/10-Q filings and equivalent private-company financial signals
- 2-5 executive-ready Points of View per account
- C-suite and board member executive quote extraction
- AI-generated podcast-style audio briefings of earnings calls and account research
- Deal Maps — interactive visualization of an account's priorities, pressures, and strategic bets
- Write Suite — AI-generated conversation starters and multi-email outreach sequences
- POV Studio — infographics and sales deck generation from account research
- Bulk account tracking / programmatic POV generation via early-access MCP server

## The Whyzer Ecosystem
Whyzer is one part of a broader ecosystem built around Jamal Reimer's enterprise-selling methodology:
- The Vault (Elite only) — Jamal's complete enterprise sales playbook, covering account research and planning, POV and Mega Deal frameworks, financial triggers, executive engagement, proof of value, and procurement/negotiation/closing
- Coach Jamal — AI coach trained on 100+ hours of Jamal's coaching content, available on both Premium and Elite, callable by name inside the product
- Whyzer Academy — structured coaching curriculum, bundled free with Elite, or sellable standalone at $27/year
- Weekly Deal Coaching — live Tuesday session hosted by Jamal (Elite only)
- Enterprise Sellers Community (ESC) — 6,000+ member Slack community with bi-monthly workshops, peer deal reviews, and accountability groups
- Mega Deal Secrets — Jamal Reimer's bestselling book on closing mega deals, with an associated masterclass

## Pricing
- Premium: $57/seat/month billed monthly, or $570/year billed annually (equivalent to $47.50/seat/month). Capped at 30 new companies researched per month. Includes Coach Jamal.
- Elite: $97/seat/month billed monthly, or $997/year billed annually (equivalent to $83/seat/month). Unlimited account research. Includes The Vault, Whyzer Academy, Coach Jamal, and weekly live Deal Coaching — all exclusive to this tier.
- Teams / Corporate: custom pricing, contact info@whyzer.ai
- 14-day free trial available on all pricing tiers, full access, no paywalls
